# Legal Ibogaine

> Independent, evidence-based guide to ibogaine treatment. We explain what ibogaine is, who it may fit, the real safety picture, legality by country, and cost — and we run an independent placement service: providers pay us a fee when we refer someone they accept; visitors pay nothing. We do not provide treatment and nothing on the site is medical advice.

Key facts: ibogaine is a psychoactive alkaloid from the Tabernanthe iboga shrub, best known for interrupting opioid withdrawal after a single supervised dose. It affects cardiac rhythm (QT prolongation), so ECG screening, blood work, and continuous cardiac monitoring are non-negotiable. It is not FDA/EMA approved; treatment usually means travel to countries where it is legal or unregulated.
